answer: The relic index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the gale queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1595 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the opal. Collateral of 22 dollars is at risk. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
